## Evaluation

### Scores
| Dimension | Score | Reasoning |
|-----------|-------|-----------|
| Correctness (25%) | 9/10 | Technically sound story breakdown with realistic point estimates fitting the 20-point velocity. Dependencies are properly identified. Minor gap: no mention of mobile push notifications despite noting mobile clients exist. |
| Depth (25%) | 8/10 | Good coverage of core notification needs with 6 well-structured stories. Questions/assumptions section shows thoughtful analysis. Could have explored edge cases (failed deliveries, notification grouping) or added a push notification story. |
| Quality (25%) | 9/10 | Excellent clarity and actionability. Stories follow proper format, acceptance criteria are testable and specific, sprint allocation is practical. Table formatting aids readability. A developer could genuinely start working from these. |
| Persona (25%) | 8/10 | Professional Scrum Master tone throughout. Demonstrates proper agile methodology (user stories, story points, velocity awareness, dependency mapping). Missing some SM-specific elements like risk identification or team capacity considerations. |
| **WEIGHTED_TOTAL** | 85/100 | |

### Overall Assessment
This is a well-crafted epic breakdown that demonstrates strong Scrum Master competencies. The response efficiently covers requirements gathering, assumption documentation, and story creation within the word limit. The prioritized sprint plan is realistic and value-driven. The main improvement opportunity would be addressing mobile push notifications explicitly given the stated constraint about mobile clients.
